tasks.title: DShot frame CRC
tasks.statement: DShot throttle **{thr}**, telemetry bit 0. Calculate the 4-bit CRC: v = throttle·2 + telemetry, CRC = (v ⊕ v>>4 ⊕ v>>8) & 0xF. Give the answer as a decimal number 0–15.

tasks.title: Internal resistance from sag
tasks.statement: At no load the pack reads **{u0} V**; under a current of **{i} A** the voltage sagged by **{s} V**. Find the internal resistance of the pack (mΩ).

tasks.title: A new ibata_scale from the charger's mAh
tasks.statement: Betaflight: `ibata_scale = {s}`. Over a flight the OSD counted **{fc} mAh**, and the charger put back **{ch} mAh**. What `ibata_scale` do you set (one-point calibration, no rounding)?
tasks.solution: In current.c the current is I[mA] = 10000·U[mV]/ibata_scale + offset: the reading is inversely proportional to the scale. The flight controller counted less than was used → the scale must go down: new = old × mAh_FC / mAh_charger. The module's example: 400 × 1018/1350 = 302.

tasks.title: A new BATT_AMP_PERVLT from the charger's mAh
tasks.statement: ArduPilot: `BATT_AMP_PERVLT = {p}` A/V, `BATT_AMP_OFFSET = 0`. The log counted **{fc} mAh**, the charger put back **{ch} mAh**. What `BATT_AMP_PERVLT` do you set?
tasks.solution: I = (U − BATT_AMP_OFFSET) · BATT_AMP_PERVLT: the reading is directly proportional to the parameter, so new = old × mAh_charger / mAh_log. The direction of the proportion is the opposite of Betaflight; BAT1_A_PER_V in PX4 is calculated the same way.

tasks.title: The frequency a sampled reading shows
tasks.statement: A **{f} Hz** signal is digitized at a sample rate of **{fs} Hz** without a filter. At what frequency (Hz) will it appear in the data?
tasks.solution: f_alias = |f − k·f_s|, where k is the nearest integer to f/f_s. If f < f_s/2, the signal appears at its own frequency. The module's examples: 24 kHz at 10 kHz → 4 kHz, 117 Hz at 100 Hz → 17 Hz, 1010 Hz at 1 kHz → 10 Hz.
